description: This file defines the ViewsBlock class which provides derivative plugin definitions for Drupal Views block displays, including methods for creating instances, constructing derivatives, and retrieving derivative definitions based on view configurations.

classes.name: ViewsBlock
classes.description: Provides derivative plugin definitions for all Views block displays in Drupal, implementing ContainerDeriverInterface.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of ViewsBlock using the service container and base plugin ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewsBlock with a base plugin ID and view storage.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific derivative definition by ID, generating definitions if not already available.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for all views with block displays, including handling of display options and arguments.
